scheduled_title: Your account is scheduled for deletion
scheduled_body: It will be permanently deleted on {{date}}. Until then your links, bio pages and forms are offline. Sign in again before that date to cancel the deletion and bring everything back.
deactivated_body: Your account has been deactivated. If you believe this is a mistake, contact
enter_email_first: Enter your email first, then we send you a code.
email_code_instead: Email me a sign-in code instead
spam_title: No code yet? Take a peek in your spam folder.
spam_body: Kurz is free and has no fancy email service behind it, so our emails sometimes get lost on the way. Marking it as “Not spam” helps the next one find you.
wrong_code_message: That code is wrong or expired. After several wrong attempts, request a new one.
too_many_message: Please wait a few minutes, then request a new code and try again.
deactivated_support: Your account has been deactivated. Contact support if you believe this is a mistake.
restored_message: Your account was scheduled for deletion. Signing in cancelled it: your links, bio pages and forms are back online.
err_generic: Something went wrong, please try again later.
err_rate_limited: Too many attempts. Please wait a few minutes and try again.
err_captcha_failed: We could not confirm you are human. Please try again.
err_invalid_email: That does not look like a valid email address.
err_undeliverable_email: We cannot send email to that address. Temporary and disposable addresses are not accepted.
err_new_address_limit: New sign-ups are paused for today. If you already have an account, you can still sign in.
err_email_limit: Kurz has sent all the emails it can for now. Please try again later.
err_google_invalid_token: Google sign-in did not go through. Please try again.
err_google_email_not_verified: Your Google account email is not verified yet, so it cannot be used to sign in.
err_invalid_credentials: Wrong email or password. Too many attempts pause password sign-in for a while.
err_invalid_code: That code is wrong or expired. Request a new one if needed.
err_invalid_current_password: Your current password is not right.
err_reauthentication_required: For your security, sign in again with an email code, then set your password.
err_password_matches_email: Your password should not be based on your email address.
err_password_breached: This password appeared in a data breach, so attackers try it first. Please choose another.
password_hint: At least {{min}} characters. A few words work well.
password_short_error: Use at least {{min}} characters ({{count}} so far).
